name: Hollin
basis: Vanta's own world of BABEL, from the Mabry Curve roleplay: a living tower of themed floors wearing the skin of an unreleased full-dive game.
summary: Varrow's market town at the ford, one floor up from the Concourse, almost exactly as BABEL's beta drew it: the mill, the stone bridge, the green with its Waystone and well. Saint Aurel's white cathedral stands on one hill and Varrow Keep on the other, and eight miles up the valley the Reachwall holds back the Reach. The Close weighs the big and bans the Marked beyond the ford.

intensity.voice: pulpy and mythic in a modern frame: omens, weather and System panes, where every win carries a bill and desire is a power with a price

neighborhoods.name: Hollin
neighborhoods.summary: The market town at the ford, just as the beta drew it: the green with its Waystone and well, thatched roofs, the stone bridge, the mill and its wheel, and Goodwife Marra on her bench.

neighborhoods.name: the landing
neighborhoods.summary: The hillside above Hollin where the Stair opens onto Varrow under a pale sky, with steps down to the road.

neighborhoods.name: the Close
neighborhoods.summary: Saint Aurel's hill across the valley: the white cathedral, the cloister, the sisters' house, the guesthouse, the old cemetery with its hives, and down by the river the Pens.

neighborhoods.name: Varrow Keep
neighborhoods.summary: The Margrave's hill: the Keep's ward and hall, the solar, the manor wing, the lower barracks, the east wall-walk and the Cairn tower, and the bone-cellar under it all.

neighborhoods.name: the valley road
neighborhoods.summary: Eight miles of road between hawthorns from the Keep to the valley head, with Burners' Wood off to the east two miles short of the Wall.

neighborhoods.name: the Reachwall
neighborhoods.summary: Thirty feet of fitted stone across the valley head with a rampart walk three abreast and towers every quarter mile, the badly patched breach by the north tower, and the ditch below. Past it, the Reach.

places.name: Hollin green
places.summary: The green with the Waystone in the middle and the well and bucket at the bottom of the hill road. A board on a post by the well, in fresh black paint that was never in any build: NO MARKED BEYOND THE FORD BY ORDER OF THE CLOSE.

places.name: the ford
places.summary: Stepping stones across the river below the mill, and the Close's line: no Marked beyond it.

places.name: the mill
places.summary: The water mill and its wheel by the ford, and Goodwife Marra's stone cottage beside it, where she shells peas on the bench and sends climbers after rats in the dry cellar her husband built.

places.name: the stone bridge
places.summary: The old bridge on the Keep road, where the Keep's riders and the Close's wardens pass each other without speaking.

places.name: the Bell and Bushel
places.summary: Hollin's alehouse: small beer, bread, a fire, the Keep's men on one side of the room and the Close's lay brothers on the other.

places.name: the landing steps
places.summary: Where the Stair opens out of the floor's wall onto the hillside above Hollin. Below lies the beta, almost exactly. A Close acolyte sweeps the steps and watches who comes up.

places.name: Saint Aurel
places.summary: The white cathedral, its spires the beta's pride. In the nave hang the Scales: a black iron beam and two bronze pans big enough to stand in, over a brass arc with a sun at one end and a cracked wall at the other. One does not stand in the pan shod.

places.name: the guesthouse
places.summary: Whitewashed cells across the cloister with tin sun-discs over the doors and windows on the herb garden. No bolts on the doors; boots outside them.

places.name: the infirmary
places.summary: Brother Coll's rooms: basins, willow bark, clean linen and a Keeper's Mend.

places.name: the sisters' house
places.summary: Where the vowed sisters live, and where Sister Maud still trims a dead giant's lamp.

places.name: the old cemetery
places.summary: Sister Abelone's hives among the old graves, a prayer over each at Lauds. Her honey is the only food on Varrow that tastes to a climber.

places.name: the Pens
places.summary: The old tannery on the river, where the Close holds Marked found beyond the ford, and in autumn the wanting, until the cage goes down in spring.

places.name: the Margrave's hall
places.summary: The Keep's great hall under the black stag on silver, gray-and-blue livery, the Margrave's chair with the Muster board and his old gauntlet behind it, and a gray lurcher on the hearth.

places.name: the Margrave's solar
places.summary: His private room up the solar stair: a fire, a good table, lunch, and his dead wife's harp that nobody plays.

places.name: the Keep chapel
places.summary: A small chapel in the manor wing with a side door by the solar.

places.name: the lower barracks
places.summary: A long low room of wool, boot grease and twenty men, arrow-slit light, and in one corner a bunk nobody takes.

places.name: the Cairn tower
places.summary: The tower on the Keep's east wall-walk, his lordship's ground, with only the one stair up. From the top: the valley head, the Wall, and the beacons on the Reach.

places.name: the bone-cellar
places.summary: The catacombs under the Keep. In the beta a stair here let climbers up off the floor. It is locked, and the Margrave keeps the key.

places.name: Burners' Wood
places.summary: Woods two miles short of the Wall, with charcoal clearings where a cart can wait off the road and nobody on the rampart can see.

places.name: the rampart walk
places.summary: Three abreast along the top of the Wall, horns in every tower. At dusk you can see the beacons on the Reach ridges.

places.name: the patch
places.summary: The breach by the north tower, rebuilt badly in rubble and timber three winters ago, the color of a healed burn. Orla's plumb line and the earth ramp for hauling stone.

places.name: the north tower chapel
places.summary: A chapel in the north tower where a gift's sister keeps his lamp.

places.name: the drill ground
places.summary: Beaten earth below the tower where Captain Hode drills the company: sticks first, blunted blades after.

places.name: the ditch
places.summary: The ditch below the patch, where the giants stand when they come to talk, a little more than their own height from the rampart.

places.name: the Wall kitchen
places.summary: The company's cookhouse under the north tower: porridge, salt pork, small beer, and whatever the sisters send down.

places.name: the landing alehouse
places.summary: A two-table alehouse by the cage where porters wait for Cobb, and the Close's men watch who comes up.

places.name: the mile inn
places.summary: A posting inn halfway up the valley road with a stable, a fire and a landlady who knows every rider of the Keep.

transit.name: On foot
transit.summary: Hollin is a quarter hour end to end; the Keep and the Close are each a stiff climb; the Wall is eight miles.

transit.name: Horse
transit.summary: The Keep's riders, and a roan for a guest the Margrave likes.

transit.name: Mule
transit.summary: The Close's sisters ride white mules.

careers.name: Miller
careers.summary: Grinding at the mill by the ford.

careers.name: Wall soldier
careers.summary: A season on the Reachwall in the Margrave's company: stone, drill and the horns at dusk.

careers.name: Mason
careers.summary: Laying stone at the patch under Orla's line.

careers.name: Warden of the Close
careers.summary: A halberd and a white tabard with the gold sun.

careers.name: Lay brother
careers.summary: Working the Close's fields, kitchens and gates.

careers.name: Charcoal burner
careers.summary: Tending the kilns in Burners' Wood.

employers.name: House Corve
employers.summary: The Margrave's household and his Wall company.

career_hubs.name: The Keep and the Close
career_hubs.summary: Most of Varrow's wages come from the Margrave or the Close.

climate.summary: Varrow's valley under a real-looking sky: mild summers, a wet autumn, and the first frost that brings the Reach down and the Close's weighing.

months.note: Lammas: the Close reads the names of its kept.
The first frost, and the weighing.
The cage goes quiet until spring.

annual_events.name: Lammas
annual_events.summary: The Close reads out the names of its kept.

annual_events.name: The autumn weighing
annual_events.summary: At the first frost the Close weighs Hollin's people. Those found wanting go to the Pens.

annual_events.name: The spring cage
annual_events.summary: The Pens empty down the Stair, and nobody in Hollin watches the cage go.

local_color.name: Rats
local_color.summary: Rats is what Hollin says about the Marked when the Close is listening.

local_color.name: The gift
local_color.summary: A giant the Close weighs and keeps is its gift: a cell, a lamp, his name read at Lammas, a sister to tend him, and the Wall.

local_color.name: Sun stoles
local_color.summary: The Close marks what it keeps with white stoles and the gold sun, so the Margrave's men know whose it is.

local_color.name: The two-finger sign
local_color.summary: Close folk make a sign across the chest with two fingers at anything big, Marked or ringed-eyed.

local_color.name: Brother Hask
local_color.summary: The last gift: a giant forty years on the Wall, who slept on the floor because the Close never made him a longer bed. He died last winter in his sleep.

local_color.name: The onion game
local_color.summary: A barracks game nobody explains to outsiders.

local_color.name: Aldo went in the river
local_color.summary: The miller went in the river, Marra says, and that is all she says.

local_color.name: Close honey
local_color.summary: Sister Abelone's honey, which gives a climber a little Resolve and actually tastes.

prices.item: Room at the Bell and Bushel
A Keeper's Mend at the infirmary

notables.name: Goodwife Marra
notables.about: BABEL's tutorial quest-giver, who sends climbers after rats in her dead husband's mill cellar, and drops the script when she decides to trust you.
notables.wants: to get her rats onto the cage down

notables.name: the Archdeacon
notables.about: A Seraph with ash-gray wings and pale fire at the pupils, calm and kind-voiced, whose spoken word is obeyed. He weighs the big, and keeps what he weighs.

notables.name: Sister Ide
notables.about: Eleven years in vows, barefoot in white wool, light showing at her collarbones. She has waited all that time for a giant.

notables.name: Brother Coll
notables.about: Old, round, talkative, a Keeper's Mend in his hands; pleased to be asked, and honest about who he will have to tell.
notables.wants: to see the Bishop come home

notables.name: Brother Tamsin
notables.about: Leads the Close's wardens and reads lists somebody else wrote.

notables.name: Sister Abelone
notables.about: Keeps the hives among the old graves. Unbearable when praised.

notables.name: the Margrave
notables.about: Lean, one-armed, dry, with a gray lurcher at his feet. He owns the valley and the Close owns his soul, and he is tired of the arrangement.
notables.wants: the Wall under his own banner

notables.name: Oswy
notables.about: Long and silent; sits outside doors.

notables.name: Hennet
notables.about: Stirs the barracks porridge with a paddle and shouts at anyone near the pot.

notables.name: Captain Berit Hode
notables.about: Commands the Margrave's Wall-work company with a flattened nose and calm eyes.

notables.name: Gil Fenwick
notables.about: Heavy, gray-bearded, a face like a dropped pie. Stood a season with the last man with white-ringed eyes and buried six afterward.
notables.wants: one more season, then his sister's farm

notables.name: Orla
notables.about: Laid the Wall's first courses as a girl and directs with her chin.

notables.name: Pim
notables.about: Gangly, burn-scarred, believes everything Gil says.
